title: AbRank v2: Antibody-Antigen Affinity Ranking Benchmark
subtitle: Sequence- and Lineage-Disjoint 3-State Antibody-Antigen Affinity Ranking Benchmark
description: AbRank v2 standardizes 20-AA sequence-complete antibody-antigen and single-domain nanobody (VHH) binding measurements across 24 public experimental sources under zero-leakage (<50% antigen, <80% antibody lineage) 3-state noise-buffered ranking ({-1, 0, +1}). Code & evaluator: https://github.com/AI-SysBio/AbRank. LogiCA baseline: https://github.com/AI-SysBio/logica/tree/main/antibodies-abrank.
